integrity: The analytic proof uses the anchor's self-adjoint gapped relaxation operator and independently checks the Fokker-Planck specialization. General moment theory is treated as prior mathematical machinery, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The moment theorem is restricted to the zero-wave-number temporal expansion.
A conserved direction can miss the globally slowest nonhydrodynamic mode, so the ratio limit is the slowest relaxation time coupled to that direction.
No noisy inverse-moment or statistical estimation theorem is claimed.
title: Temporal off-shell diffusivities form a Hausdorff moment hierarchy
